author: root
claims: Common centralizer in M2 of two noncommuting SL2 involutions in characteristic two consists of scalars.
For two commuting nonabelian involution pairs in Sp4 over an algebraically closed field of characteristic two, their full symplectic centralizers commute.
Every connected involutory string in Sp4 in characteristic two has length at most five.
classical_interface: Simplicity of Sp4(q),q>=4, only to infer connectedness for a full-group marking.
prior_roles: Root derived and wrote Jordan/commutant argument; enumeration_volume independently proposed an unused exterior-square route.
